com.vector.cfg.model.groovy.api

Interface IOperations


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IOperations
    IOperations is the entry point for some complex operations on the AUTOSAR data model.
    The model operations implement convenient means to execute complex model changes like AUTOSAR module activation or cloning complete model sub-trees. The operations API is available inside of a transaction with the keyword operation. The class IOperations defines the available methods.

    • Method Detail

      • activateModuleConfiguration

        @PublishedMethod
com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.ecucdescription.MIModuleConfiguration activateModuleConfiguration(DefRef moduleDef)
        The method activateModuleConfiguration(DefRef) activates the specified module configuration. This covers:
        • Creation of the module including the reference in the ActiveEcuC (the ECUC-VALUE-COLLECTION)
        • Creation of mandatory containers and parameters (lower multiplicity > 0)
        • Applying the recommended configuration
        • Applying the pre-configuration values

        Note: If the DefRef has a wildcard, activateModuleConfiguration(DefRef) tries to activate the most specific module definition matching the wildcard, if unique. If it is not unique the method will throw an exception. For example the DefRef /[ANY]/Dio will activate the /MICROSAR/Dio instead of /AUTOSAR/EcucDefs/Dio. 

         
 transaction{
     // Activates the Dio module
     operations.activateModuleConfiguration(sipDefRef.Dio)
 }
        Parameters:
        moduleDef - is the module definition
        Returns:
        the new module configuration
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException -
        • the passed DefRef has a wildcard, and there are multiple specific definitions matching the wildcard
        • the passed DefRef is no Module DefRef
        • the passed DefRef is no TypedDefRef, if it has wildcards
        • the passed DefRef has no valid model definition
        • the passed DefRef has no valid model definition
        java.lang.IllegalStateException - If the activation of the module configuration failed inside the model.

      • createUniqueMappedAutosarPackage

        @PublishedMethod
com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.base.MIARPackage createUniqueMappedAutosarPackage(AsrPath packagePath,
                                                                                                           java.nio.file.Path filePath,
                                                                                                           IVersion autosarVersion)
        The method #createUniqueMappedAutosarPackage() can be used to create new MIARPackages in new arxml files. It creates an new instance of the specified AUTOSAR package and adds it to the model tree. All non-existing parent packages will be created too. The new package (including new created parent packages) will be mapped uniquely to the specified location (Path and AUTOSAR version).
        Parameters:
        packagePath - is an AUTOSAR path specifying the new package
        filePath - the file path to create
        Returns:
        The new package
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if the specified AUTOSAR package already exists

      • deactivateModuleConfiguration

        @PublishedMethod
void deactivateModuleConfiguration(com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.ecucdescription.MIModuleConfiguration moduleConfiguration)
        Deactivates (removes) the specified module configuration.
        The method deactivateModuleConfiguration(MIModuleConfiguration) deletes the specified module configuration from the model. In case of a split configuration, the related persistency location is being removed from the project settings. In XML file base configurations, the related file is being deleted during the next project save if it doesn't contain configuration objects anymore. If the module configuration is referenced from the active-ECUC this link is being removed too.
        Parameters:
        moduleConfiguration - is the module configuration to remove

      • deepClone

        @PublishedMethod
<T extends MIObject> T deepClone(T source,
                                                   MIObject destinationParent)
        The deepClone(MIObject, MIObject) operation copies (clones) a complete MDF model sub-tree and adds it as child below the specified parent.
        • The source object must have a parent. The clone will be added to the same MDF feature below the destination parent then
        • AUTOSAR UUIDs will not be cloned. The clone will contain new UUIDs to guarantee unambiguousness
        Parameters:
        source -
        destinationParent -
        Returns:
        the cloned object

      • setConfigurationVariantOfAllModuleConfigurations

        @PublishedMethod
 @PublishedFilter(value=MsrPlatform.class)
boolean setConfigurationVariantOfAllModuleConfigurations(com.vector.cfg.model.access.ecuconfiguration.EEcucConfigurationVariant ecucConfigVariant)
        Set the implementation configuration variant for all active MIModuleConfigurations. See IActiveEcucApi.getAllModules() for the used module configurations.
        setConfigurationVariantOfAllModuleConfigurations(EEcucConfigurationVariant) sets the implementation configuration variant of all active MIModuleConfiguration. If a module configuration does not support the requested variant it is ignored.

        Supported enum values are:

        • EEcucConfigurationVariant
          • VARIANT_PRE_COMPILE
          • VARIANT_LINK_TIME
          • VARIANT_POST_BUILD_LOADABLE

        This is for post-build loadable only! See the method setConfigurationVariant() in class IEcucModuleConfiguration for details.

        Parameters:
        ecucConfigVariant - the EEcucConfigurationVariant to set
        Returns:
        true, if all modules could be changed to the requested EEcucConfigurationVariant
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if the EEcucConfigurationVariant is not one of EEcucConfigurationVariant.VARIANT_PRE_COMPILE, EEcucConfigurationVariant.VARIANT_LINK_TIME, EEcucConfigurationVariant.VARIANT_POST_BUILD_LOADABLE
